# module: protolint
# case:   base
# vars:
#   EXTRA_ARGS=BASE-EXTRA_ARGS

=== task: fix ===

    "BASE-TARGETS"
    BASE-EXTRA_ARGS \
    gopath=\"$(go env GOPATH)\"
  "$HOME/go/bin/protolint" lint -fix \
  BASE-EXTRA_ARGS <"$file_list"
  echo 'No matching protobuf files found'
  exit
  exit 0
  fi
  filter "SKIPFILES_PATTERN=$skip_pattern" >"$file_list"
  find "$target" -type f -name '*.proto' -print0
  gobin=\"$(go env GOBIN)\"
  gobin=\"${gopath:-$HOME/go}/bin\"
  gopath=\"${GOPATH:-}\"
  if [ -z \"$gopath\" ] && command -v go >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  printf '%s\000' "$target"
" result: "$HOME/go/bin"
elif [ -f "$target" ]; then
fi
fi
fi
fi
fi | task --silent --taskfile "$REPO/taskfiles/protolint/../internal/skipfiles/Taskfile.yml" \
file_list="$(mktemp)"
if [ ! -s "$file_list" ]; then
if [ -d "$target" ]; then
if [ -z "$skip_pattern" ]; then
if [ -z \"$gobin\" ] && command -v go >/dev/null 2>&1; then
if [ -z \"$gobin\" ]; then
printf '%s' \"$gobin\"
target='BASE-TARGETS'
